Method of Attack: Allows attacker to create archives that can be extracted anywhere on filesystem accessible to Zimbra, enabling arbitrary file upload through Amavis, overwriting Zimbra webroot, implanting shellcode, and accessing other users' accounts
Attack Vector: Uploading specially crafted .cpio, .tar, or .rpm archives via email to Zimbra server
Indicators of Compromise: Exploitation allows deployment of web shells to Zimbra root, shellcode implantation, unauthorized account access
